item.title: Kerr delivers masterclass for White Ferns
item.description: Melie Kerr (left) celebrates with White Ferns after the dismissal of Zimbabwe's Adel Zimunhu at University Oval today. Photo: Getty Images Melie Kerr is a handful of wickets away from becoming New Zealand’s most successful ODI bowler.

item.title: Blast at US embassy in Norway
item.description: The US embassy in Oslo. Photo: Getty Images (file) The US embassy in Oslo has been hit by an explosion, causing minor damage but no injuries, Norwegian police say.

item.title: Working together to learn more
item.description: Meteors over Middlemarch detected and captured by a "fireball" camera. Photos: Ian Griffin On calm nights in Middlemarch, when the wind drops and the paddocks fall quiet, my usual practice is to step outside before bed and gaze upwards.

item.title: Cleanup begins after oil leak in Akaroa Harbour
item.description: The oil spill is contained on Akaroa Harbour. Photo: Facebook/Environment Canterbury A Royal New Zealand Navy vessel has spilled hundreds of litres of oil into Akaroa Harbour on Saturday morning.

item.title: Activist urges action as govt looks to scrap clean car standard
item.description: Climate Liberation Aotearoa's Jen Olsen said all the figures show electric vehicles are a better option. Photo: Getty Images A climate activist says it is up to individuals to do the right thing if the government will not do more to reduce vehicle emissions.

item.title: Project behind overhaul of firearms regulations on hold
item.description: A cache of firearms seized from a property in Gore in 2025. Photo: supplied/NZ Police By Phil Pennington of RNZ An IT project behind the overhaul of firearms regulations has been put on hold, due to uncertainty over what is needed.

item.title: Latuselu to look at Rabbitohs setup
item.description: Waitaki Girls’ High School student Ana Latuselu will head to Sydney this weekend for a training camp with NRLW club South Sydney Rabbitohs. PHOTO: NIC DUFF Ana Latuselu is hopping across the Ditch in hopes of impressing NRLW scouts.
